E0511

`Expiring.force` bypasses fallible cache-expiry access — use `get(clock)` (D-TTLVAL1)

What

`Expiring.force` bypasses fallible cache-expiry access — use `get(clock)` (D-TTLVAL1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0511

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0511: tests/ui/expiring_force_unwrap.stderr.

Error [E0511]: `ExpiringValue.force` bypasses expiry checking
  --> tests/ui/expiring_force_unwrap.jet:9:15
    |
  9 |     _ :: item.force(clk)
    |               ^^^^^
 Why: TTL-wrapped values must use fallible `get(clock)` so expired access is handled explicitly
 Fix: use `match item.get(clock) { .Ok(v) -> …; .Err(Expired) -> … }` instead
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0511
